tools.name: Adobe MCP

clients.label: Another client with MCP server configuration

readiness: Node.js 18 or later is installed (Homebrew installs it for you).
The Adobe app you want to use is installed on this computer.
Your MCP client can launch local stdio servers.
You know which project folders the server should be allowed to access.

claude-code|brew.command:
brew tap zachshallbetter/tap
brew trust zachshallbetter/tap
brew install zachshallbetter/tap/adobe-mcp
claude mcp add --scope user adobe -- adobe-mcp-suite
claude-code|brew.explanation: Homebrew installs Node.js 18 or later for you. Registers the Adobe MCP coordinator, which provides two Illustrator-to-InDesign workflows. To use an app's own tools, register its server too (adobe-mcp-photoshop and so on), or let creative-mcp setup pick the servers that match your apps.

claude-code|npm.command: claude mcp add --scope user adobe -- npx -y adobe-mcp-suite
claude-code|npm.explanation: Registers the Adobe MCP coordinator, which provides two Illustrator-to-InDesign workflows. To use an app's own tools, register its server too (adobe-mcp-photoshop and so on), or let creative-mcp setup pick the servers that match your apps.

claude-desktop|brew.explanation: Homebrew installs Node.js 18 or later for you. Add this entry to Claude Desktop's config file (~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json), keeping any servers already there. The path is Homebrew's on Apple silicon; on an Intel Mac it is /usr/local/bin. Registers the Adobe MCP coordinator, which provides two Illustrator-to-InDesign workflows. tools.name: Blender MCP

clients.label: Another client with MCP server configuration

readiness: Homebrew is installed (or Rust and Cargo, to build from source).
Blender is closed while you run blender-mcp addon install, so it can turn the add-on on for you.
Your MCP client can launch local stdio servers.

claude-code|brew.command:
brew tap zachshallbetter/tap
brew trust zachshallbetter/tap
brew install zachshallbetter/tap/blender-mcp
blender-mcp addon install
blender-mcp client add claude-code
claude-code|brew.explanation: Installs the CLI, lets it install and turn on the companion add-on (quit Blender first), then registers the local server with your client. Blender MCP requires Blender 4.0 or later.

claude-code|cargo.command:
cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/zachshallbetter/blender-mcp-rs --package blender-mcp-cli
blender-mcp addon install
blender-mcp client add claude-code
claude-code|cargo.explanation: Installs the CLI, lets it install and turn on the companion add-on (quit Blender first), then registers the local server with your client. Blender MCP requires Blender 4.0 or later.
